Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program and the person,
each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

description:
`artifacts/artifact/v1` at `/artifacts/<id>`: one claude.ai artifact.

`<id>` is the last segment of `url`. `first_seen` is the first publish
or read the mod saw, or for an import the listing row's `updatedAt`, or
the import time when the row has none. The version records under
`<id>/versions/` hold each version the board saw; the newest is the
artifact's current version. Only `artifacts.agree` sets `state` to
`agreed`, naming the owner's decision in `agreed_by`.

account.description:
The claude.ai account that published the artifact, as a person named
by the account's email address.

agreed_by.description: The owner's decision that moved the artifact to agreed.

area.description:
Tags that place the artifact among neighbouring work, such as
dashboard/flows.

first_seen.description: When the board first saw the artifact, with a time zone.

shows.description:
One sentence saying what the page is for; left out until an agent
sets it.

state.description:
Where the owner's review stands: draft until it is shown, shown once
the owner has seen it, agreed once the owner's decision accepts it,
and superseded once a newer artifact replaces it.

subject.description:
The task and change the artifact belongs to; left out when it
belongs to none yet.

superseded_by.description: The artifact that replaces this one, once it is superseded.

url.description: The artifact's claude.ai link, such as https://claude.ai/artifact/AbCdEf0123456789xyzQ.

title: ArtifactRecord
